from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import requests,json,hashlib,threading,re
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
soup=BeautifulSoup((out/'sources/官方按年借款预估目录.html').read_bytes(),'html.parser')
year=None;all_entries=[]
for tr in soup.find('table').find_all('tr'):
 text=' '.join(tr.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
 if re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}',text):year=int(text);continue
 for a in tr.find_all('a'):
  label=a.get_text(' ',strip=True).replace('\u200b','');m=re.match(r'([1-4])(?:st|nd|rd|th) Quarter',label)
  if year and m:all_entries.append({'quarter':str(year)+'Q'+m.group(1),'url':urljoin('https://home.treasury.gov',a['href'])})
wanted=set(protocol['fixed_current_quarters'])|{'2021Q4'}
entries=sorted([x for x in all_entries if x['quarter'] in wanted],key=lambda x:x['quarter'])
assert len(entries)==17 and len({x['quarter'] for x in entries})==17
assert not (out/'release_receipts.json').exists()
frozen={'frozen_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'catalog_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'sources/官方按年借款预估目录.html').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'entries':entries,'equity_labels_loaded':False,'quarter_selection_changed':False}
(out/'catalog_selection_freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(frozen,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
reuse={'https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1453':'sources/20230501_Treasury借款预估原文.html',
 'https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1662':'sources/20230731_Treasury借款预估原文.html'}
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1'
local=threading.local();throttle=threading.Event()
def fetch(entry):
 url=entry['url'];quarter=entry['quarter'];p=out/('sources/'+quarter+'_借款预估原公布.html')
 rec={'quarter':quarter,'url':url,'path':str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),'attempts':[]}
 if url in reuse:
  original=parent/reuse[url];p.write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
  rec.update(status='REUSED_E10_ORIGINAL',sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=p.stat().st_size,reused_from=str(original.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'));return rec
 if throttle.is_set():rec['status']='NOT_REQUESTED_SOURCE_THROTTLE';return rec
 if not hasattr(local,'session'):
  local.session=requests.Session();local.session.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
 for attempt in range(1,3):
  r=None;a={'attempt':attempt,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
  try:
   r=local.session.get(url,timeout=(15,35));a['http_status']=r.status_code
   if r.status_code in (403,429):throttle.set()
   r.raise_for_status();p.write_bytes(r.content);a['status']='SAVED_ORIGINAL';rec['attempts'].append(a)
   rec.update(status='SAVED_ORIGINAL',sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content));return rec
  except Exception as e:
   a.update(status='FAILED',error=str(e)[:800]);rec['attempts'].append(a)
   if r is not None and r.status_code in (403,429):break
 rec['status']='FAILED_AFTER_REGISTERED_ATTEMPTS';return rec
receipts=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
 for future in as_completed([pool.submit(fetch,e) for e in entries]):receipts.append(future.result())
receipts.sort(key=lambda x:x['quarter'])
(out/'release_receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tls_verify':True,'receipts':receipts},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
table_candidates=[];metadata=[]
for rec in receipts:
 if rec['status'] not in ['SAVED_ORIGINAL','REUSED_E10_ORIGINAL']:
  print('未取得：',rec['quarter'],rec['status']);continue
 s=BeautifulSoup((root/rec['path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser');text=' '.join(s.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
 start=text.find('Treasury Announces Marketable Borrowing Estimates',text.find('Quarterly Refunding Financing Estimates')+1)
 monthdates=re.findall(r'(?:January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+\d{1,2},\s*\d{4}',text[:text.find('WASHINGTON')])
 date=monthdates[-1] if monthdates else None
 links=[{'label':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'url':urljoin(rec['url'],a.get('href',''))} for a in s.find_all('a') if 'sources and uses' in a.get_text(' ',strip=True).lower()]
 images=[{'label':x.get('alt',''),'url':urljoin(rec['url'],x.get('src',''))} for x in s.find_all('img') if 'sources and uses' in x.get('alt','').lower()]
 if rec['quarter']!='2021Q4':
  table_candidates.append({'quarter':rec['quarter'],'date':date,'links':links,'images':images})
 metadata.append({'quarter':rec['quarter'],'body_date_text':date,'source_url':rec['url']})
 print(rec['quarter'],date,'原表链接：',json.dumps(links or images,ensure_ascii=False))
(out/'actual_release_metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
(out/'table_candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(table_candidates,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('正文已取得：',sum(x['status'] in ['SAVED_ORIGINAL','REUSED_E10_ORIGINAL'] for x in receipts),'/17')
